title: CI Observe — Overview
description: E2E CI health at a glance for the VMaaS, CaaS and BMaaS suites.

list.name: days

list.description: How far back to look. 'vs before' compares with the same span just before it.

list.label: Suite

list.description: The VMaaS, CaaS and BMaaS E2E suites.

options.content: **E2E CI at a glance: the VMaaS, CaaS and BMaaS suites.** Choose a *Window*, *Suite*, *Started by* and *Repository* above; every page in the bar keeps them. Hover a panel's **ⓘ** for exactly what it counts. Names are links: a suite opens its time or failures, a test its history, a run its page (or GitHub when it was not recorded).

panels.title: Pass rate
panels.description: Passed runs ÷ (passed + failed). Population: passed and failed VMaaS, CaaS and BMaaS suite runs; cancelled runs are left out. Time: runs created in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: percent.

panels.title: First-try pass rate
panels.description: Runs that passed without a re-run ÷ (passed + failed). A run someone re-ran on GitHub counts as not passing the first time, even when the re-run passed. Pass rate counts only a run's last attempt, so the gap between the two tiles is failures that a re-run hid. Population: passed and failed VMaaS, CaaS and BMaaS suite runs; cancelled runs are left out. Time: runs created in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: percent.

panels.title: Pass rate change
panels.description: This window's pass rate minus the previous window's, in percentage points. Green: better. Population: passed and failed VMaaS, CaaS and BMaaS suite runs; cancelled runs are left out. Time: runs created in the last $days days (the Window above); 'vs before' compares with the $days days before. Unit: percent.

panels.title: Runs re-run
panels.description: Runs someone re-ran on GitHub (Re-run jobs). Pass rate shows only their last attempt, so a failure before the re-run is not in it. Population: finished VMaaS, CaaS and BMaaS suite runs. Time: runs created in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: count of runs.

panels.title: Typical time to result
panels.description: Median time from GitHub creating a run's first job to its last job finishing: what a developer waits for a green result, the wait for a runner included. Population: passing VMaaS, CaaS and BMaaS suite runs. Time: runs created in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: duration.

panels.title: Slow runs take
panels.description: The 90th percentile: 9 in 10 passing runs finish faster than this. Population: passing VMaaS, CaaS and BMaaS suite runs. Time: runs created in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: duration.

panels.title: Typical wait for a runner
panels.description: Median time a run's E2E job waited in GitHub's queue for a self-hosted runner. Population: finished suite runs with a stored job timeline (runs stored before timelines existed have no runner wait). Time: runs created in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: duration.

panels.title: Failures caused by CI
panels.description: Share of the failed runs whose first failed step was CI infrastructure (cluster or hosts, CI setup, logs or teardown, a timeout, a lost runner), not the tests, the build or the OSAC install. Population: failed VMaaS, CaaS and BMaaS suite runs (GitHub said failure or timed out). Time: runs created in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: percent.

panels.title: Runs
panels.description: Runs that finished. Population: finished VMaaS, CaaS and BMaaS suite runs (passed, failed or cancelled). Time: runs created in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: count of runs.

panels.title: Failed runs
panels.description: Runs GitHub marked failed or timed out. Population: failed VMaaS, CaaS and BMaaS suite runs (GitHub said failure or timed out). Time: runs created in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: count of runs.

panels.title: Runner hours
panels.description: Wall-clock hours of every finished run. Population: finished VMaaS, CaaS and BMaaS suite runs (passed, failed or cancelled). Time: runs created in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: hours.

panels.title: Runner hours on failed runs
panels.description: Share of the runner hours spent on runs that failed. Population: finished VMaaS, CaaS and BMaaS suite runs (passed, failed or cancelled). Time: runs created in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: percent of hours.

panels.title: Flaky tests
panels.description: Tests that both passed and failed on the same commit. Population: test results in the JUnit reports of the suite runs; a skipped test is not a run. Time: runs created in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: count of tests.

panels.title: Tests with a failure
panels.description: Distinct tests that failed at least once. Population: test results in the JUnit reports of the suite runs; a skipped test is not a run. Time: runs created in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: count of tests.

panels.title: Suite health
panels.description: One row per suite and one for all three. 'Time' and 'Failures' open that suite's pages. First try: share that passed without a re-run. Re-runs: runs someone re-ran on GitHub. Population: finished VMaaS, CaaS and BMaaS suite runs (passed, failed or cancelled). Time: runs created in the last $days days (the Window above); 'vs before' compares with the $days days before. Unit: count of runs, percent and duration as named.

panels.title: Where a passing run spends its time
panels.description: The average passing run of each suite, phase by phase: the wait for a runner, then each group of workflow steps (in every job of the run). Open 'Where the time goes' for the steps. Population: passing VMaaS, CaaS and BMaaS suite runs. Time: runs created in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: duration.

panels.title: Why runs failed
panels.description: Failed runs of each suite by the phase of their first failed step. Tests: a test failed. Build and OSAC install: the code under test did not build or install. CI infrastructure: the cluster, the hosts, CI setup, teardown, a timeout or a lost runner. Blocked: an unapproved fork or refused inputs. Population: failed VMaaS, CaaS and BMaaS suite runs (GitHub said failure or timed out). Time: runs created in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: count of runs.

panels.title: Pass rate per day
panels.description: Passed ÷ (passed + failed) per day, per suite and for all three; the dashed line is the first-try pass rate of all three (a run that needed a re-run counts as not passing). Population: passed and failed VMaaS, CaaS and BMaaS suite runs; cancelled runs are left out. Time: one point per UTC day the runs were created, last $days days. Unit: percent.

panels.title: Typical time to result per day
panels.description: Median time to a green result per day, per suite and for all three, the wait for a runner included. Population: passing VMaaS, CaaS and BMaaS suite runs. Time: one point per UTC day the runs were created, last $days days. Unit: duration.

panels.title: Where the tests' time goes
panels.description: The recorded tests' own time, split four ways: setup (fixtures), waiting for the product (every poll_until wait: OSAC reconciling a resource), test actions (the rest of the test: CLI and API calls, assertions) and teardown. A long orange segment is time spent in the product, not in the test. Population: recorded suite runs with a complete trace (a ci-observe capture whose spans are in Tempo). Time: runs created in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: percent of the tests' time.

panels.title: What the tests wait for in the product
panels.description: Hours of poll_until waits by the kind of resource the test waited on, the biggest first: where OSAC's reconcile time goes, as the tests see it. Population: recorded suite runs with a complete trace (a ci-observe capture whose spans are in Tempo). Time: runs created in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: hours.

panels.title: Tests that fail most
panels.description: Tests with at least one failure, the most failures first. Flaky commits: commits on which the test both passed and failed. Click a test for its history. Population: test results in the JUnit reports of the suite runs; a skipped test is not a run. Time: runs created in the last $days days (the Window above); 'vs before' compares with the $days days before. Unit: count of runs, percent and duration as named.

panels.title: Tests that take the most time
panels.description: Tests by their total time across all runs: where shortening a test saves the most. 'vs before' compares the typical (median) duration with the previous window. Population: test results in the JUnit reports of the suite runs; a skipped test is not a run. Time: runs created in the last $days days (the Window above); 'vs before' compares with the $days days before. Unit: duration and percent as named.

panels.title: Latest failed runs
panels.description: The newest failed runs: their cause and the step they stopped in. Population: failed VMaaS, CaaS and BMaaS suite runs (GitHub said failure or timed out). Time: runs created in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: time and duration as named.

value.title: Open the run (GitHub when it was not recorded)

panels.title: Pull requests merged in the window
Merged pull requests
panels.description: Pull requests merged. Population: pull requests merged in the selected repository. Time: merged in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: count.

panels.title: Open to merge
panels.description: Median time from opening a pull request to its merge. Population: pull requests merged in the selected repository. Time: merged in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: duration.

panels.title: Wait for first review
panels.description: Median time from ready for review to the first human review. Population: pull requests merged in the selected repository. Time: merged in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: duration.

panels.title: Review to approval
panels.description: Median time from the first human review to the first approval. Population: pull requests merged in the selected repository. Time: merged in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: duration.

panels.title: Approval to queue
panels.description: Median time from the first approval to entering the merge queue. Population: pull requests merged in the selected repository. Time: merged in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: duration.

panels.title: In the merge queue
panels.description: Median time from entering the merge queue to the end of its last attempt. Population: pull requests merged in the selected repository. Time: merged in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: duration.

panels.title: Rebased
panels.description: Share of the merged pull requests force-pushed at least once (a rebase or a rewrite). Population: pull requests merged in the selected repository. Time: merged in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: percent.

panels.title: E2E reruns per PR
panels.description: Median E2E runs beyond the first of each suite (a re-run or a new run of the same suite) of a merged pull request that ran E2E. Population: pull requests merged in the selected repository with at least one VMaaS, CaaS or BMaaS E2E run. Time: merged in the last $days days (the Window above). Unit: runs per pull request.

panels.title: About these numbers
panels.description: What this page counts, over which window, what is missing or partial, and when each source was last written, as the API computed it. Population: the page's own population, named in the first column. Time: the window in the second column. Unit: text.
